Destinations / Meghalaya

Meghalaya

Living root bridges, crystal rivers and the cloud kingdom

Best time: October – April. Short drives between sights; some root-bridge treks have 3,000+ steps.

Highlights

  • Double-decker living root bridge
  • Glass-clear Umngot river at Dawki
  • Mawlynnong, “cleanest village in Asia”
  • Nohkalikai Falls

Suggested road trips

Shillong → Cherrapunji → Dawki

5 days · about 260 km. Canyons, waterfalls, root bridges and the clearest river in India.

  1. Guwahati → Shillong (100 km, about 3 h)
  2. Shillong → Sohra (Cherrapunji) (55 km, about 2 h)
  3. Sohra → Nongriat root bridges (10 km, about 1 h): Steep steps down to the double-decker bridge.
  4. Sohra → Dawki via Mawlynnong (95 km, about 3.5 h)
  5. Dawki → Shillong (85 km, about 3 h)

Before you go

Shillong about 1,500 m.

Fill up in Shillong and Sohra; fewer pumps near Dawki.

Winding and often wet; landslides in the monsoon (June–September). Drive slowly in fog.
